description: This file contains transformation logic to convert Cohere's rerank API response format to Together AI's rerank response format. It defines a class with a method that processes API response dictionaries, validates the presence of required fields, constructs typed response objects, and handles missing data or errors.

classes.name: TogetherAIRerankConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that contains a method to transform rerank API responses from one format to another.

methods.name: RerankResponse _transform_response(self, response: dict)
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary response from Cohere's rerank API into a structured RerankResponse object, validating necessary fields and processing each result.
